messages:
Maya Chen: Quick thread — final prep for next week's webinar. Need: 1) final abstract, 2) speaker order + backups, 3) rehearsal times, 4) inbound lead routing plan, 5) run-of-show with fallbacks. Can we lock these today? :eyes:
Ravi Patel: I have the abstract draft, will post in a sec. want it on the registration page by EOD.
Alex Torres: Heads up — I'm traveling Tue morning. I can do speaker slot but need a backup for the live demo.
Jordan Lee: I'll be the moderator. Recommend a 5 minute intro, 3x 12min talks/demos, 15min panel Q+A. Also suggest pre-recorded demo as fallback.
Priya Singh: For inbound leads — we should add a 2-field router on the registration form: 'Deployment interest' + 'Company size'. That will map to SDR queues.
Sam O'Neill: I'll wire HubSpot -> Slack routing. Plan: tag leads with "webinar:scaling-inference" and route >50k ARR to AE queue. Need final form fields and timezone.
Maya Chen: Abstract draft (Ravi take):
```
Serving LLMs at Production Scale — How teams reduce latency and cost while keeping quality.
Join engineers from Redwood to learn practical patterns: routing, batching, caching, and fallbacks that keep apps online.
Who should attend: infra/platform/ML engineers & engineering managers.
Takeaways: measurable latency wins, cost controls, and a reproducible runbook for rollouts.
```
Ravi Patel: Edits made — shortened headline and added bullets. Pushed to Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/example (please review).
Alex Torres: I can take the main demo but @Jordan Lee please slot me before the panel so we can tease the demo during the Q+A. If I drop, @Ravi Patel can run the recorded walkthrough.
Jordan Lee: Noted. Backup plan: if demo fails, we run the pre-recorded clip + do live Qs on architecture. Also include a quick slide with a short CLI snippet so we can show something even without GPU access.
Priya Singh: Routing details: add hidden field `utm_campaign=webinar_scaling` and `interest=deployment` so we can filter in HubSpot. Also request permission to send a 1-click survey after the webinar.
Sam O'Neill: Rehearsal schedule proposal:
- Tue 10:00 PT: Full run with slides + demo (all presenters)
- Thu 09:00 PT: Tech-check only (no dress rehearsal)
I'll create calendar invites and include a join link + pre-record upload location.
Maya Chen: Run-of-show (30–45 min options):
```
00:00 - 05:00 Intro + host remarks (Jordan)
05:00 - 17:00 Talk 1: Serving runtime & kernels (Ravi)
17:00 - 29:00 Talk 2: Routing & fallback strategies (Alex)
29:00 - 34:00 Short demo (Alex) OR pre-recorded fallback
34:00 - 44:00 Panel Q&A (All)
44:00 - 45:00 CTA + close (Jordan)
```
Maya Chen: Tech checklist for rehearsals: mic check, presenter screen share, demo GPU access verified, recorded fallback uploaded to shared drive, host cue cards, slide deck exported to PDF.
Ravi Patel: I'll upload the recorded walkthrough by Mon EOD. File: Drive > Marketing > webinars > scaling_inference > fallback.mp4
Alex Torres: Demo smoke test steps (quick):
1) start docker container
2) run `curl localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
3) confirm latency < 200ms for 50 tokens
If any step fails, switch to fallback.mp4 and narrate KV-cache slides.
Jordan Lee: Moderator notes: prepare 3 leading questions, ask one about SLA tradeoffs, one about cost/quantization, one about rollout risk. Keep panel to 12 minutes.
Priya Singh: Registration copy tweak: replace 'Who should attend' line with 'For engineering teams building latency-sensitive LLM features'. Also add checkbox to opt-in for post-event benchmark report.
Sam O'Neill: I'll set HubSpot form + routing rules by Tue 2pm PT. Will post webhook payload example in this thread when done.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Webinar "Serving LLMs at Production Scale" — Tue 2026-07-14 16:00 UTC. Invite: https://calendar.example/event/abc123
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Ravi: finalize doc + upload fallback.mp4 (due Mon EOD)
- Sam: HubSpot form + routing (due Tue 2pm PT)
- Alex: demo smoke test and share steps in drive (due Tue 9am PT)
- Jordan: moderator q's + cue cards (due Tue 12pm PT)
I'll run the full rehearsal Tue 10:00 PT. Ping me if any of the owners need to swap. :thumbsup:
